data.body: [P2] Retain completed parent identities for late checkpoint deliveries. A child can create callback B and return its ID, after which B completes during a root step. The child's terminal hook has already removed its span from `_operation_spans`, so this new check indefinitely defers B's completion when the step checkpoint delivers it—even though B's own placeholder exists. Invocation cleanup discards the queued completion, and checkpoint acknowledgment prevents redelivery. Preserve the completed parent's span context for subsequent descendant completions, and add a regression where B completes after its child context returns but before the invocation ends.
